original_test_intent: Verify every packed entry in the SMBIOS Type 10 onboard-device list reports the approved device-type enum and enabled status for the device identified by its description, and that the complete legacy inventory remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Parse all Type 10 entries from the formatted-area length, preserve each raw type/status byte and description string index/value, compare ordered or identity-mapped entries to the approved board inventory, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the Type 10 inventory, status/description mapping, legacy-versus-Type 41 policy and reboot plan. No device enable/disable or functional exercise is required.
required_inputs: Expected Type 10 device type per entry or stable description identity
Expected enabled bit per onboard device
Board revision and allowed entry ordering/duplicate description policy
Policy for platforms that also publish or migrate to Type 41 Onboard Devices Extended Information
Raw-capable parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and optional read-only OS inventory; do not enable/disable devices, change BIOS settings or load/unload drivers.
Preserve the packed raw byte because its high bit is status and lower bits encode device type.
Derive entry count from Type 10 formatted length and validate every type/status plus description-index pair; do not stop at the first entry.
Do not replace the requested Type 10 check with Type 41; any Type 41 comparison is additive because record models differ.
Do not claim device presence or functionality from metadata alone; stop on malformed entries, drift or reboot failure with no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Parse all raw Type 10 entries, decode type and status separately, resolve descriptions, compare the complete inventory and optionally report additive Type 41/OS correlations before/after reboot.
Do not alter device state or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the expected legacy inventory and how Type 10 coexists with Type 41 on this platform.
Approve reboot/recovery, request separate functional checks if needed and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The target concept is valid, but `Onboard Device Type` may not be the decoder's literal label, and `-A1` cannot preserve every packed entry's status and description identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 10 structures, calculate entry count from formatted length and emit raw type/status byte, decoded enum, enabled bit and resolved description for every entry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 10 Onboard Device Type scope, source script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode every Type 10 entry from raw structure length, split type/status bits, resolve its paired description and compare the full identity map; collect Type 41 only as additive migration/correlation evidence when published.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Platforms that publish SMBIOS Type 10 On Board Devices Information.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, board and parser/dmidecode versions and whether Type 41 is also published.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 10 packed entry layout and device-type enumeration, Type 41 semantics when used additively, approved board inventory and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Uses raw multi-entry parsing and status/description binding instead of a fragile one-line type grep; it does not substitute Type 41 for Type 10.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage by validating every packed entry, enabled bit and string identity while preserving the legacy target.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Complete expected Type 10 inventory and coexistence/migration policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Type 10 is legacy metadata and lacks the richer location/BDF identity of Type 41; OS correlation may remain ambiguous.

project_override_considerations: A project may define that Type 10 is intentionally absent in favor of Type 41 only through an explicit platform baseline; this case must then record the policy rather than silently executing Type 41 and claiming Type 10 passed.
expected_evidence: Approved board revision, complete Type 10 type/status/description inventory and Type 10/Type 41 policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 10 raw structure with formatted length, calculated entry count and every raw/decoded entry
Per-entry type, enabled-status and description-identity results; optional Type 41/OS correlation separately labeled
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot inventory diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source clearly identifies the Type 10 device-type field; the legacy nature and decoder-label mismatch affect method, not intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Type 10 can be safely parsed when present, and intentional absence can be judged against an explicit project policy.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects a fragile label grep and adds packed status, entry count and description identity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains board/status safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Preserves the original Type 10 target and treats Type 41 only as additive evidence, avoiding coverage substitution.

review_improvement: Prevents checking only one onboard device, losing its enable bit or silently replacing the legacy structure with Type 41.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 10 is a length-defined sequence of packed type/status and string-index pairs; complete parsing and comparison are deterministic software operations.
